milestone: N1 native ownership, shared reservations and two-context store
decision: adopt N1 foundation for later opt-in integration; stop at exhausted implementation budget before N2
preserved_prior_results: native-weather-N1-summary.json records failed native attempts 1/2 and their then-unclassified interpretation; the present record corrects that interpretation, not their original FAIL verdicts

controls.name: identical QSB bytes at a distinct URL

attempt_3.finding: Cached shared shader URL left the second ShaderEffect status at Uncompiled despite correct real rendering. This was an overstrict harness readiness predicate, not proof that the second widget could not present.
attempt_3.earlier_upload_count_correction: The old zero for the failed second phase was computed with an empty attributable handle set because the compiled-status guard returned no group. It was NOT a measured zero GPU-upload submission count. Earlier failed-case trace counts must not be used as upload evidence.
attempt_3.correction: Permit independent readback when four actual endpoint handles are present and no explicit ShaderEffect error exists. Continue requiring known nonblank pixels, separate handles, actual upload positives and every resource/eviction check. Keep original shared shader URLs and normal atlas settings.

final_validation.additional_oracles: Cached Uncompiled metadata permits known-pixel readback, but missing endpoints/native readiness or explicit shader errors still fail; a clean exit/unknown group cannot certify cache acceptance
final_validation.diagnostic_warnings: macOS Cocoa/intents service messages; no native context ownership errors

limits: N1 is a synthetic production-store/component test, not normal-application presenter or real-forecast integration
Four-endpoint scalar controls use the existing opaque packed encoding; full production barb/fill/reference-sampler gates remain N2/N3
32 MiB default cap is a configurable trial allocation, not a ratified workload-fit or physical-VRAM bound
QRhi upload submission is not hardware completion; readback is correctness, not FPS or presentation latency
A failed phase with no mapped group has unattributable upload counts; do not interpret its numeric zero as measured zero
The cached-shader metadata result must be handled when implementing truthful native presenter readiness
next_decision: Budget exhausted with N1 supported. Seek a new bounded N2/N3 integration budget before wiring the cache into actual maps/layers; no default switch or issue closure follows automatically.
